title: Edit the /account Portion of Member Dashboard URL | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Edit the /account Portion of Member Dashboard URL Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000089676 The member dashboard URL by default is linked to: www.yourdomain.com /account/home However depending on the site verbiage or language this may need to be changed. There is an advanced setting that will allow the / account portion of the URL to be updated: Member Dashboard URL System Variable: default_account_url Add the text into the field, save the changes and the URL is immediately updated without needing to reset anything: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
